title: 2003 AMC 12A Problem 2
statement: Members of the Rockham Soccer League buy socks and T-shirts. Socks cost \(\$4\) per pair and each T-shirt costs \(\$5\) more than a pair of socks. Each member needs one pair of socks and a shirt for home games and another pair of socks and a shirt for away games. If the total cost is \(\$2366,\) how many members are in the League?

solutions.text:
A T-shirt costs \(4+5=9\) dollars.

Each member needs two pairs of socks and two shirts, costing \(2(4)+2(9)=26\) dollars.

The number of members is \(2366 \div 26 = 91.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Each member buys two pairs of socks and two shirts
